title: A comparable Version type
hints: Parse in __init__: strip, drop a leading 'v', split on '.', check every piece with str.isdigit() (it is False for the empty string, which rejects '1..2' and '1.' for free), then map int over them.

Strip trailing zeros with a while loop that stops when one element is left. After that, (1, 2) == (1, 2) and (1, 2) < (1, 2, 1) are exactly the answers you need, so __eq__ and __lt__ just compare self.parts.
Both comparison methods should `return NotImplemented` when other is not a Version. __hash__ is hash(self.parts). repr is f"Version({str(self)!r})".
